partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Disease-module-central top-three target
results.hypothesis: For genetically heterogeneous disease, an inhibited top-ranked causal target is more relevant when it physically interacts with at least two other top-ten disease genes.
results.body: Drug decreases a top-three causal target embedded in a disease-specific PPI module with at least two other top-ten genes
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule selects one intervention point by disease-relative network embedding rather than requiring the drug to hit several genes, but unsigned interactions and noisy effects remain.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; disease-relative ranks, distinct-neighbor cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[target_evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->
      (object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(neighbor:Gene)
      -[neighbor_evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE target <> neighbor
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND target_evidence._miner_disease_rank >= 1
  AND target_evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND neighbor_evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 10
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, target, object,
     collect(DISTINCT neighbor) AS neighbors,
     collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WHERE size(neighbors) >= 2

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Evidence-independent disease-module-central target
results.hypothesis: A disease-module-central target is more reliable when its directional effect is repeated and its physical binding is supported by at least two primary databases.
results.body: R397 with repeated directional evidence and multi-database target binding
results.mechanism_rationale: Disease-relative network centrality selects the target, while independent binding databases and repeated directional evidence strengthen the intervention edge.
results.trapi_notes: The graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; evidence aggregation, source cardinality, disease ranks, neighbor count, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[target_evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->
      (object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(neighbor:Gene)
      -[neighbor_evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE target <> neighbor
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(
        effect.evidence_count,
        size(coalesce(effect.publications, [])),
        1
      ) >= 2

  AND target_evidence._miner_disease_rank >= 1
  AND target_evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND neighbor_evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 10
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, target, object,
     collect(DISTINCT neighbor) AS neighbors,
     collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WHERE size(neighbors) >= 2

WITH subject, target, object, neighbors,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,
         source IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, []) |
         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated
           ELSE accumulated + source
         END
       )
     ) AS binding_sources
WHERE size(binding_sources) >= 2

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Lower-ranked disease-module-central target control
results.hypothesis: The same network and provenance architecture on causal targets ranked four through ten is a disease-relevance control for R398.
results.body: R398 architecture with target rank four through ten
results.mechanism_rationale: Network embedding and evidence quality are retained while disease-relative target relevance is deliberately reduced.
results.trapi_notes: Same expressibility constraints as R398, with a lower target-rank interval.
